convention: Cell-level collaboration presence should show ownership without blocking nearby work.
whyItMatters: NodeRoom's spreadsheet needs fast human plus agent coediting instead of visible reservation-style locks.
nodeRoomTranslation: Presence claims and short agent intent chips sit on cells as advisory state; final writes still use CAS.

convention: Multiplayer cursors and object-level activity are visible but do not freeze the canvas.
whyItMatters: Agent work should feel present and interruptible, not hidden behind a loading wall.
nodeRoomTranslation: Agent planning and commit leases are presence rows, while proposal cards appear only for meaning conflicts.
doNotCopy: branching claims NodeRoom does not implement

convention: Triage collects work that must be accepted, assigned, or dismissed.
whyItMatters: Passive findings and agent proposals must not silently mutate professional artifacts.
nodeRoomTranslation: Noteworthy inbox, proposal chips, trace rows, and job cards keep next actions explicit.
doNotCopy: developer-only issue tracker language for first-time finance users

convention: Empty writing surfaces should invite capture without saving placeholder text.
whyItMatters: Fast messy note capture is the first step before passive intelligence can help.
nodeRoomTranslation: Notebook ghost text appears only in the empty first paragraph and never persists to Convex.
doNotCopy: generic personal-doc framing when the room is a finance war room

convention: Records need identity, source chips, and dense relationship context.
whyItMatters: Banking diligence rows are not anonymous cells; source-backed company identity drives trust.
nodeRoomTranslation: Company rows use initials, source chips, status, and evidence-bearing fields.
doNotCopy: CRM-only workflow assumptions that hide artifact provenance

convention: Chat and generated work product should be adjacent, with reviewable output state.
whyItMatters: The user needs to talk to the agent while inspecting the exact artifact being changed.
nodeRoomTranslation: Copilot, Work Surface, Trace, and proposal chips keep chat, artifact, and proof connected.
doNotCopy: treating chat transcript as durable memory or source of truth
